unresolved_gaps.why_it_matters: For a Backend Engineer role, your portfolio lacks evidence of unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), or API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), which are essential for professional backend development.

unresolved_gaps.gap: Missing deployment or cloud infrastructure experience
unresolved_gaps.why_it_matters: Backend roles require familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and deployment strategies; your current projects are primarily local scripts or notebooks, which do not demonstrate the ability to host and maintain live services.

work_experience.title: Python Backend Engineer
work_experience.description: Design and build scalable, cloud-native microservices on AWS for a UK insurance partner onboarding platform, owning 6+ production services end-to-end from technical design through deployment and support.Developed a multi-type file ingestion service handling parsing, validation, data quality checks and reconciliation, exposed through REST APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation. Built a Lambda-based automation service using ETag-based concurrency control for safe distributed writes, integrated into a Step Functions state machine to remove manual intervention from a previously manual process. Built an event-driven monitoring service using EventBridge and SQS/SNS to detect and alert on missing data, replacing a manual daily monitoring process. Contributed core components to a distributed orchestration workflow (AWS Step Functions) coordinating processes across 5+ systems with retry logic and fault tolerance; resolved cross-account access issues in collaboration with DevOps. Authored the project's first Low Level Design (LLD) documentation standard, later adopted team-wide, and contributed to operational runbooks for production issue diagnosis and resolution. Participate in code reviews and design discussions; implemented a full testing strategy (unit, integration, end-to-end BDD) achieving 100% coverage on key components, and support production systems through monitoring and troubleshooting via CloudWatch.
